platform: Ophelia Records Official Demo Email Route
manual_review_reason: Ophelia Records publishes demos@opheliarecords.com specifically for demos but does not publish complete delivery instructions, attachment limits, accepted link providers, release-status rules, rights declarations, response times or submission-frequency limits. A human must confirm label and track fit, prepare an authorized private streaming or non-expiring download route rather than assuming attachments are accepted, review all metadata and rights, approve the pitch and personal data, and send the email manually. The separate general-inquiries mailbox must not be used for demo delivery.
